senses.definition: vb. make distinct, declare (NH separate oneself, Pi. separate, explain, so Aramaic פְּרַשׁ, especially Pa.; Syriac ܦܪܰܫ separate, distinguish, explain, cf. Mand., NöM 221);—
Inf. cstr. לִפְרשׁ לָהֶם עַל־פִּי י׳ Lv 24:12 (P) to declare distinctly to them.
Pt. נִפְרָשׁוֹת Ez 34:12 read prob. -שׂוֹת, v. פרשׂ.

Pf. 3 ms. פֹּרַשׁ Nu 15:34 (P) what should be done to him had not been distinctly declared; Pt. מְפֹרָשׁ Ne 8:8 made distinct (cf. Biblical Aramaic Ezr 4:18), v. BeRy KöEinl. 99, > interpreted, Ke al., BerlinerT. Onk.ii. 74.
